title: •Lando Calrissian
caption: •Lando Calrissian (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}. Once per turn, if at a battleground, may use 1 Force to add or subtract 1 from any just drawn destiny. Once per turn, may ▲ A Real Hero.
lore: Scoundrel and gambler. Petty administrator of a small Tibanna gas mining operation. Easily coerced. Has problems of his own. Had dealings with the Tonnika Sisters – twice.
copyright: TM & © 1997 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1997 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 3 / ABILITY 3 / FORCE-ATTUNED (label only); deploy 2 / forfeit 4. Yellow (DS) pilot-power icon followed by '3.' at the start → {pilot:3} (stub expands 'Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots'); the slip prints ▲ where the stub expands 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Icon column top to bottom: pilot (yellow DS helmet), warrior (blue, blaster). Alien (Cloud City grey alien frame, single Alien disc; printed icons Pilot, Warrior). The Dark Side Lando: wiki base page 'Lando Calrissian (Dark) (Original)' (the bare 'Lando Calrissian' page is the Light Side card; 'Lando Calrissian (Dark)' default carries the printed text too, PC Errata on a separate page). The 745 px CC-D-landocalrissian.gif is tagged D-E1 (PC errata face: 'Deploys only on Cloud City.' and 'gambler' in bold in the lore) — downloaded to src/vs6/42-CC-D-landocalrissian.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore corrected from scan: the dash in 'Tonnika Sisters – twice' is a spaced en dash on both scans (wiki has a hyphen). Copyright 1997 (Cloud City) not legible on the 350 px face. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2-D-landocalrissian-pre.gif, 350 px; non-pre also exists, not downloaded).
